scope: Separately authorized engineering continuation of a completed proposal-only pilot on its owned saved board. Ordinary installed controls performed all engineering actions.

observations.first_routing_attempt: Finish gaps closed both opens and protected the original track. It also made one redundant ground trace. Operator rejected the candidate at rendered review and kept its receipt.
observations.second_routing_attempt: Selected nets and Completion only, with unchanged placement and 85-second budget. All added routes were on the two affected nets.
observations.wall_scope: Elapsed includes analysis, accessibility waits, two route attempts, engineering work interleaved between stages and independent readback. It is not typical user task time.
observations.product_friction: The placement handoff initially selected rerouting unlocked copper, despite the preserve-copper placement. Finish gaps still added unrelated ground copper. The Conversation pane repeated an obsolete next action after search.
observations.automation_friction: The accessibility driver needed settled popup state and a checkbox confirmation; one Preview attempt before checking the saved-source confirmation launched no work. Two control-read assertions used the wrong accessibility value type. None changed board files.

raw_evidence: Local GUI receipts and screenshots, both route attempts, preserved source, fresh export and independent readback remain on the Mac.
